items.title: Louis James Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: That name sounds familiar, but I just can't place it.

ctx.x: One other man I was going to ask you about, he was more of a boy in your time, Jimmy Noon. Do you remember? Jimmy Noon.
They called him some? Jimmy Noon. He played more when he got to Chicago on clarinet. Do you remember him playing clarinet here?
